desc: Parse input: read N, arrays A, B, C.
Identify sets P (1->0) and Q (0->1). Calculate m = |P| + |Q|.
Calculate Base cost: sum of $m \cdot A_i \cdot C_i$ for $i \notin P \cup Q$.
Calculate Offset: $(m+1) \sum_{i \in Q} C_i - \sum_{i \in P} C_i$.
Construct list of values $V$: for $i \in P$, $V_i = C_i$; for $i \in Q$, $V_i = -C_i$.
Calculate Variable Cost: $\sum_{j=1}^m j \cdot V_{j-1}$ (0-indexed array).
Print Total Cost = Base + Offset + Variable Cost.
